proposals.evidence: Reviewed whole-form continuation of Kal sor “one hundred” (f_7ipim4ej4sft6). Family evidence: CDIAL 12278 śata gives Kho šor, Mai šal and L./H. sau hundred. These r/l or diphthong-final hundred responses fit the documented numeral family. Reviewed comparator: RathwiBareli sou “one hundred” (f_udqqblgsrb75g). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved. The present source form was inspected for phonetic and gloss differences; normalization was used only to find it, and its exact spelling is preserved.
